_schema.description: Published voting-intention polls, scraped from Wikipedia by scripts/refresh.py.

fields.id: Stable id: <pollster slug>-<end_date>, with -2, -3 for repeats (used by poll.html#<id>)
fields.client: Commissioning client (newspaper, party, lobby group), or null if none or not published
fields.sample_size: Integer respondents, or null if not published
fields.source_url: The poll's first citation on Wikipedia (pollster release or news report), or null
fields.primary: Map of party code -> primary vote %. Codes: ALP, LNP (Liberal + National), GRN, ONP, IND, OTH
fields.tpp: Two-party-preferred %: {ALP, LNP}; omitted when the poll did not publish an ALP v L/NP figure
fields.approval: Optional: {matchup, leaders: {surname: {positive, negative, undecided, net}}} (net = positive - negative, as published)
